text:
Predicates:
Student(x) ::: x is a student.
WorkLibrary(x) ::: x currently works in the library.
FromCS(x) ::: x is from the computer science department.
PartTimeJob(x) ::: x has a part-time job offered by the university.
TakeDatabase(x) ::: x is taking the database course.
TakeClassDavid(x) ::: x is taking a class with Professor David.
WorkLab(x) ::: x is working in the lab.

Premises:
∀x ((Student(x) ∧ WorkLibrary(x)) → ¬FromCS(x)) ::: None of the students who currently work in the library are from the computer science department.
∀x ((Student(x) ∧ PartTimeJob(x)) → WorkLibrary(x)) ::: All of the students with part-time jobs offered by the university currently work in the library.
∀x ((Student(x) ∧ TakeDatabase(x)) → FromCS(x)) ::: All of the students who are taking the database course are from the computer science department.
∀x ((Student(x) ∧ TakeClassDavid(x)) → TakeDatabase(x)) ::: All of the students taking a class with Professor David are taking the database course.
∀x ((Student(x) ∧ WorkLab(x)) → TakeClassDavid(x)) ::: All students working in the lab are taking a class with Professor David.
Student(james) ∧ WorkLab(james) ::: James is a student working in the lab.
¬WorkLab(james) ∨ ¬PartTimeJob(james) ::: James doesn't work in the lab or have a part-time job offered by the university.

Conclusion:
TakeDatabase(james) ::: James takes the database course.
